Added today PROPERTY TYPE Terraced BEDROOMS 2 BATHROOMS 2 SIZE 1,003 sq ft 93 sq m TENURE Leasehold 1 +4 Description A rare two-bedroom, two-bathroom flat spanning over 1,000 sqft on the second floor of a grand white stucco building on Eaton Square, complete with lift access and one of the very few properties on the square to benefit from a long lease. Ceiling heights soar over 3m, adding to the sense of scale and grandeur. The elegant reception room boasts three large sash windows overlooking the garden square, flooding the space with natural light, while a separate kitchen offers practicality. Both bedrooms feature built-in storage, with the principal suite enjoying its own en suite bathroom. Residents benefit from access to Eaton Square’s private gardens, 24-hour security, and a world-class Belgravia address. Eaton Square is one of London’s most prestigious addresses, moments from Sloane Square, Knightsbridge, and the boutiques and restaurants of Elizabeth Street. Disclaimer: All images have been virtually staged. Please contact the branch for more information.
